name: Microsoft Teams
author: Jan Renz
description: Teams chats and channels in the Omarchy bar and in a window of their own. A dropdown behind the bar icon for your presence and what is unread; everything else in the window. Needs python3 (standard library only) and an Azure app registration of yours - see the README. Talks to Microsoft Graph and nothing else.

barWidget.description: Unread chats in the bar, with a dropdown for your presence and what is waiting; the conversations open in their own window.

schema.label: Account name
schema.description: A short name for this sign-in, e.g. work. Letters, numbers, dot, dash and underscore.

schema.label: Azure client id
schema.description: Required. Your own app registration's Application (client) ID. Teams cannot reuse a registration made for mail: a registration declares which permissions it may request. See the plugin README for the exact setup.

schema.label: Authority
schema.description: common, organizations, or your tenant id. Leave empty for common.

schema.label: Include teams and channels
schema.description: Off signs in for chats alone. On also asks for channel access, which normally needs an administrator to consent for the whole tenant - if that consent is refused the sign-in fails, and chats-only will still work.

schema.label: Send files
schema.description: Adds an Attach button and lets a file dropped on the window go into the chat you are reading. It needs Files.ReadWrite on your app registration - the file goes to your own OneDrive first, into the same folder Teams itself uses, and the message points at it. Turn this on only once the registration has that permission: a scope it does not declare fails the whole sign-in, not just itself. Changing this means signing in again.

schema.label: Set your presence
schema.description: The p key and the status chip: Available, Busy, Do not disturb, Be right back, Appear away, Appear offline, and Automatic to hand it back to Teams. Needs Presence.ReadWrite on your app registration - reading everybody's presence does not need an administrator, but writing your own does. Turn this on only once the registration declares it, because a scope it does not declare fails the whole sign-in. Changing this means signing in again.

schema.label: Let Teams see you at this machine
schema.description: A presence you set only shows while Teams believes you are signed in somewhere; with no Teams client running anywhere you are Offline whatever you pick. This makes the plugin one of those clients - available while somebody is at the machine, away once nobody is - renewed every twenty minutes and let go when the shell stops. Needs the setting above.

schema.label: Spacing
schema.description: How much room the window gives things. Scales the theme's own spacing, so it follows your font size rather than fighting it.

schema.label: Stop polling while you are away
schema.description: A poll is also a token refresh, and Graph counts every one of them. Nothing is asked of the server while the screen has been idle for five minutes or the machine has no network, and a fetch goes out the moment you come back or reconnect. Anything you ask for by hand still goes out either way. On battery the interval is doubled, and tripled in the power-saver profile.

schema.label: Bar icon
schema.description: Nerd Font glyph shown in the bar. Ignored when a label is set.

schema.label: Bar label
schema.description: Short text shown instead of the icon, e.g. TEAMS.

schema.label: Keybinding name for the dropdown
schema.description: A name of your own for this widget's dropdown, so a key can summon it: set teams here and bind `omarchy-shell teams toggle`. Empty means the dropdown opens by clicking the icon alone. The window is separate and always answers to `omarchy-shell shell toggle janrenz.omarchy.teams`.

schema.label: Highlight the bar icon when a chat is unread
Notify when a new message arrives
schema.description: A desktop notification for each chat that has something new in it. What was already waiting when the shell started is not announced, and neither is anything you sent yourself.

schema.label: Hand a conversation to your coding agent
schema.description: Adds the a key and an Ask agent button, which open the coding agent you chose in Omarchy on the chat or channel you are reading. No message text leaves the window - the agent is told which conversation to read and reads it through the same helper this window uses. Off means neither the key nor the button is there, and a draft sent back from an agent is refused.
